blocks.en: Let $\bm{\Phi}$ be a $k$-diffeomorphism of $\mathbb{R}^m$. Then $\bm{\Phi}^*$ is a bounded linear mapping from $H^{k-1/2}(\mathbb{R}^m)$ to itself.
blocks.zh: 设 $\bm{\Phi}$ 为 $\mathbb{R}^m$ 的 $k$ 阶微分同胚. 那么 $\bm{\Phi}^*$ 为从 $H^{k-1/2}(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 到其自身的有界线性映射.
blocks.label: cor:fractional-order-diffeomorphism-pullback

blocks.en: We simply extend $\bm{\Phi}$ to $\mathbb{R}^{m+1}$ by defining\[\bm{\Psi}(\bm{x}^{\prime},x_{m+1})=(\bm{\Phi}(\bm{x}^{\prime}),x_{m+1}).\]Then $\bm{\Psi}$ is a $k$-diffeomorphism of $\mathbb{R}^{m+1}$ and $\bm{\Psi}^*$ is continuous from $H^k(\mathbb{R}^{m+1})$ into itself. The rest follows by taking traces.
blocks.zh: 只需定义\[\bm{\Psi}(\bm{x}^{\prime},x_{m+1})=(\bm{\Phi}(\bm{x}^{\prime}),x_{m+1}).\]从而将 $\bm{\Phi}$ 延拓到 $\mathbb{R}^{m+1}$. 那么 $\bm{\Psi}$ 为 $\mathbb{R}^{m+1}$ 的 $k$ 阶微分同胚, $\bm{\Psi}^*$ 为从 $H^k(\mathbb{R}^{m+1})$ 到其自身的连续映射. 其余结论由取迹得到.
